correctness.rationale: For \(H(x)=\lambda(x-x^\star)^2/2\), the source direction is exactly \(d=-re\), with \(r=\alpha\lambda/s\), and its model quantity is \(-r\lambda e^2/2\). Substitution into the source Armijo inequality reduces it exactly to \(tr\le2-\eta\). Minimality of the geometric backtracking index yields the accepted band \(\beta(2-\eta)<tr\le2-\eta\) after a rejection. The lower source bounds imply \(r\ge r_0\), giving the endpoint contraction envelope. The minimax formula is proved by a two-case balance at \(2\beta/(1+\beta)\). A packaged checker replays the algebra and dense numerical stress tests.

value.rationale: The source deliberately separates an automatically chosen learning rate from an Armijo relaxation and emphasizes robustness to parameter tuning. The finding quantifies that interaction exactly: it turns the source's qualitative full-sample convergence into a global Q-linear guarantee on the canonical strongly convex scalar mode, identifies the three extremal backtracking mechanisms, and gives a closed-form minimax setting of the Armijo parameter for any reduction factor beta. This directly informs tuning and reveals when the raw learning-rate lower bound, rather than backtracking, is the rate bottleneck.
